requirements.requirement: The builder serializes manifest.json using RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme, writes those exact bytes to the archive, and signs those exact bytes with Ed25519. The Android verifier MUST NOT semantically trust or reserialize the manifest before signature verification. Because key_id is inside the signed JSON, the release trust store is intentionally small: the verifier tries the raw 64-byte signature against each pinned release public key (maximum eight keys in KPack 1.0), requires exactly one key to verify, then parses manifest.json and requires publisher.key_id to match that verified key. Only after this step may schema, compatibility, paths, counts, or calibration fields be accepted.

requirements.requirement:
.kpack selected
      ↓
read ZIP central directory; reject traversal / absolute / duplicate / symlink / type violations and enforce count/size limits
      ↓
read raw manifest.json (bounded size) + raw 64-byte manifest.sig
      ↓
WITHOUT trusting JSON fields, try signature verification against the bounded built-in trust-store keys; require exactly one matching public key
      ↓
parse the now-authenticated manifest; require publisher.key_id == matched key and validate schema/compatibility
      ↓
stream-extract payloads to .staging while computing SHA-256; manifest.json and manifest.sig are control files and are not entries in manifest.files
      ↓
compare every declared payload hash + byte length and reject undeclared payloads
      ↓
validate KDX1 header/count/hashes/norms
      ↓
copy knowledge.sqlite to a disposable writable validation DB; run PRAGMA integrity_check, foreign_key_check, schema audit, and FTS5 external-content integrity-check(rank=1); delete validation copy
      ↓
keep the hash-verified staged knowledge.sqlite unmodified and mount it read-only after activation
      ↓
fsync staging → atomic rename into packs/<pack_id>/<version> → registry transaction switches active version → retain previous version for one-step rollback
requirements.boundary: atomic lifecycle, explicit older warning/no automatic rollback, correct-CRC tamper negatives
requirements.limits: Controlled faults, actual process SIGKILL/hot journals and physical UI are distinct; no physical power-cut or exhaustive crash claim.

requirements.requirement: Automatic rollback to an older version is forbidden. A deliberate user rollback is permitted from Pack Details and must display an “older content” warning. When a newer valid version is installed, the previous version may be retained until the next successful app restart or until storage cleanup, whichever is later.
